title: Accept by empty stack: one state is enough
notes: Hopcroft and Ullman's version of the same construction: the stack starts as S, there is one state and no accept states, and the machine accepts when the input is used up and the stack is empty. With Options set to accept by final state, this machine accepts nothing.
ops: start q0; stack S; q0 eps, S -> q0 aSb; q0 eps, S -> q0 eps; q0 a, a -> q0 eps; q0 b, b -> q0 eps
